verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with reference pages, an llms.txt file and markdown docs. None of it shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found that all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths return 404. llms.txt and markdown docs are adjacent documentation formats, not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
